Name: GESTURE_PARAM_ST
Description: Gestures. The row ID is the gesture ID used by events, CharaInitParam and the gesture menu. Unlocking a gesture also gives its goods item when the player doesn't have it.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build.

Fields.Name: Goods ID
Fields.Description: EquipParamGoods row of the gesture. The gesture menu takes the name and icon from this goods row, and unlocking the gesture adds this goods item if the player doesn't own it.

Fields.Name: Message Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation played by the phantom of a player message left with this gesture attached.

Fields.Name: Cannot Use while Riding
Fields.Description: Is it prohibited to use while riding (default )? If , it cannot be used while riding
